title: Family cards you can come back to
description: Put a collage together from your own photographs and save the project so you can return to it before the next occasion.

blocks.text: A card for a family occasion may be needed again with a different photograph and date. A finished picture made for sending does not make that swap easy a few months later.

quote.text: Pic Collage is the best little App! It takes your photos from an image into a mini scrapbook. So easy to use and to share pictures.

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result
The editable composition, the images and the captions are all saved. You can open the earlier project, replace one shot and get a new copy, leaving the previous version in the archive.
Where the idea has an advantage

What is worth testing is reusing a card you already know. In this scenario a reliable project is worth more than a large stream of templates. For a separate product, it has to be established whether people come back to work like this often enough.
